narrative: 当左右互为镜像，画面里就没人独占某一侧的秘密。空间因此变得仪式化。
一个微小的破绽——歪掉的领带、缺失的一盏灯、一个偏离轴线一步的人——就会成为整个事件的焦点。当生活本该显得未经安排时，这个手法就用错了。
厨房里的争吵、一场追逐、纪录片式的街道：硬要在那里造出镜像就是一种谎言，除非谎言本身就是重点（样板间、极权政体、一场梦）。对称构图（Symmetry）不等于把一张脸摆在正中央。
一条镜像长廊，足以吞没一个稍稍偏离标记位的人物。建筑依然掌控着这张图。
how: 把摄影机放在场景的中轴线上。让实景光源、家具和垂直线都彼此对应。
用水平仪校准。单点透视（One-Point Perspective）有帮助，但不是必需——一堵平面的建筑立面，不需要透视隧道也能形成镜像。
如果两翼都要保持清晰，就缩小光圈。提示词：Perfect symmetry around [Subject], mirrored architecture, a central axis, obsessive order.
when: 当场景本身是一台秩序的机器时使用：酒店、教堂、宇宙飞船、法庭、玩偶屋。不要把它当壁纸，贴在一个根本没有轴线的场地上。
vs: 中心构图（Centered Composition）是把主体放在轴线上。对称构图是让整个画面互为镜像，主体在不在轴线上都可以。
单点透视是一种常常制造出对称效果的透视结构，但两翼也可能在一张平坦、浅景深的画面里对应，而没有透视隧道。重复与图案（Repetition and Pattern）重复的是单元，不要求镜像。
非对称构图（Asymmetry）则是对这一切的拒绝。
examples_film: 《布达佩斯大饭店》（The Grand Budapest Hotel）把酒店当作服务的镜像图解来处理。《2001太空漫游》（2001: A Space Odyssey）用轴向、左右对称的秩序，来主张未来是被设计出来的。
在这种秩序上留下一处指纹，就会被读成错误或凶兆。这是语法，不是滤镜。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是把演员摆在中央，却让房间不对称。破绽是一张靶心式的脸，窗户却只在左边有一扇。
解决办法是把摄影机移到建筑轴线上，或者干脆放弃对称的主张，拍出带有真实配重的非对称构图。

faq.q: 电影中的“对称构图”是什么？
faq.a: 画面里的各个团块围绕一条轴线（通常是竖直中线）彼此平衡，左边呼应右边。这个世界看起来是被设计出来的。人物可以坐在轴线上，建筑本身也可以就是那个对称的主体。

faq.q: 对称构图 vs 中心构图
faq.a: 中心构图关心的是主体在轴线上的位置。对称构图关心的是团块的镜像关系。你可以在一个不对称的房间里把人摆在中央，也可以拍一条镜像长廊，而演员偏离中心。这两者常常同时出现，却不是同一套图解。

faq.q: 什么时候该用对称构图？
faq.a: 当秩序本身就是意义所在时使用：仪式、控制的喜剧、科幻设计、极权政体的建筑。不要把它硬贴在一条根本没有轴线的街道上。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写对称构图的提示词？
faq.a: 要求镜像和轴线。示例：Perfect symmetry around [Subject], mirrored architecture, a central axis, obsessive order. 指定实景光源要对应，摄影机要放在中轴线上。如果故事的重点是那处不对应的破绽，就明确指出唯一的那一处。

narrative: When left mirrors right, nobody owns a secret side of the frame. Space is ceremonial.
A small break (a crooked tie, a missing lamp, a person one step off axis) becomes the whole event. It is the wrong tool when life should feel unarranged.
A kitchen argument, a chase, a documentary street: forcing a mirror there is a lie unless the lie is the point (a showroom, a regime, a dream). Symmetry is not the same as centering a face.
A mirrored corridor can swallow a figure who is slightly late to their mark. The architecture still owns the diagram.
how: Place the camera on the centerline of the set. Match practicals, furniture, and verticals.
Use a level. One-point architecture helps but is not required: a flat elevation of a facade can be a mirror without a vanishing tunnel.
Stop down if both wings must stay sharp. Prompt: Perfect symmetry around [Subject], mirrored architecture, a central axis, obsessive order.
when: Use it when the location is a machine of order: hotel, chapel, spaceship, courtroom, dollhouse. Do not use it as wallpaper on a location that has no axis.
vs: Centered Composition plants a subject on the axis. Symmetry mirrors the field, with or without that subject.

One-Point Perspective is a perspective construction that often produces symmetry, but two wings can match in a flat, shallow picture with no tunnel. Repetition and Pattern repeats units without requiring a mirror.
examples_film: The Grand Budapest Hotel treats hotels as mirrored diagrams of service. 2001: A Space Odyssey uses axial, bilateral order as a claim that the future is designed.
A fingerprint on that order reads as error or omen. Grammar, not a filter.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a centered actor in an unmatched room. The tell is a bullseye face and a window only on the left.
The fix is to move the camera onto the architectural axis, or to drop the claim and shoot Asymmetry with real counterweight.

faq.a: It is a frame whose masses balance around an axis, usually the vertical center. Left answers right. The world looks designed. A person may sit on the axis, or the architecture may be the symmetrical subject.

Centered composition is about the subject's seat on the axis. Symmetry is about mirrored masses. You can center a person in an asymmetric room, and you can shoot a mirrored hall with the actor late to center. They often travel together. They are not the same diagram.
Use it when order is the meaning: ritual, comedy of control, science-fiction design, a regime's architecture. Do not glue it onto a street that has no axis.

faq.q: How do I prompt symmetry for AI image or video?
faq.a: Ask for a mirror and an axis. Example: Perfect symmetry around [Subject], mirrored architecture, a central axis, obsessive order. Specify matching practicals and a camera on the centerline. Name one break if the story is the unmatched thing.
